design_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Tactical Athletic Precision)
file_type_instruction: All component files in this repository are JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Use prop validation or default standard React JavaScript patterns.
theme_strategy: High-contrast athletic command center theme with support for Dark Mode (Slate Obsidian #0B0F17 background) and Light Mode (Clean Warm Off-White #F8FAFC background). Features traffic-light status highlighting for rapid roster triage.

spacing_and_layout.athlete_checkin_flow: Mobile-first single column optimized layout (max-w-xl mx-auto). Large touch targets (minimum 48px height for buttons and rating pills). Generous spacing between wellness sections (py-8, gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.coach_dashboard: High-density tactical grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6). Header with quick status summary counters (Total Athletes, Checked In %, Follow-ups Needed, High Load Alert). Full width responsive Squad Status Table with sticky athlete name column.

WellnessRatingSelector.description: 5-point scale rating control with visual color feedback (1=Poor/Severe to 5=Excellent/Optimal). Uses pill-shaped buttons with active ring highlights and icons.
WellnessRatingSelector.accessibility: Full keyboard focus,aria-pressed, and data-testid attributes per score pill.

TrafficLightBadge.description: Visual indicator tag with background tint, solid dot indicator, and clear text label for Sleep, Hydration, Motivation, Illness, Soreness, and Load.
TrafficLightBadge.style: px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 border

SquadStatusTable.description: Interactive data table highlighting today's athlete status with quick search, filter by readiness (All, Red Alert, Amber Watch, Pending), and click-to-view detailed athlete card.

SorenessBodyMap.description: Visual or interactive checklist for muscle soreness areas (Lower Back, Hamstrings, Quadriceps, Calves, Shoulders, Knees, Ankle/Foot, Upper Back/Neck) with severity slider (1-5).
SorenessBodyMap.style: Grid of body region badges with interactive intensity selectors

RPELoadCalculator.description: Computes Session Training Load automatically: Load = Session RPE (1-10 scale) x Duration (minutes). Display live calculated workload value with acute load zone badge (Low <300, Moderate 300-600, High >600).
RPELoadCalculator.style: Live numeric counter with color-coded gauge ring or workload progress bar

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY: Every input, button, select, card, table row, tab, modal trigger, filter, and action element MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

motion_and_microinteractions.framer_motion_transitions: Smooth accordion reveals for Illness details and Soreness sections. Staggered fade-in for Squad Status table rows. Subtle scaling scale-95 on click for rating buttons.
motion_and_microinteractions.hover_states: All hover states must explicitly specify text color to prevent invisible contrast (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white).
motion_and_microinteractions.toast_notifications: Use sonner for instant feedback on check-in submission, athlete additions/removals, and Excel data download.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app with clean React components in .js format under /app/frontend/src/.
Provide a toggle or header switch between 'Athlete Daily Check-In' (public mobile view) and 'Coach Command Center' (password protected).
Implement the full Athlete Daily Check-In form with sleep, hydration, motivation ratings, illness details, muscle soreness details, and session RPE load calculator.
Implement the Squad Status table on the Coach Dashboard with traffic-light cell background indicators (Green, Amber, Red, Grey) as specified.
Include Roster Management to dynamically add/remove team athletes.
Provide Excel export functionality (using xlsx library or standard CSV/Excel format download).
Store data cleanly via backend FastAPI endpoints or client-side mock persistence with clear API models so no mock data is lost on submit.
Ensure data-testid attributes exist on all interactive components per the testing guidelines.
